input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

This scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？：请问，我们可以吃什么植物？，“请问” introduces a polite question; “麻烦” normally means troubling someone and needs a structure such as “麻烦你……”. [rule: word_choice]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 以后：后来，At the beginning of a sentence, “后来” means “afterwards”; “以后” usually means “after a specified event or time”. [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，“别人” distinguishes other people from a person already mentioned, while “人们” refers to people generally. [teacher rule: bieren]

items.reason: “麻烦” cannot directly introduce this question, while “请问，我们可以吃什么植物？” is a correct polite question.
At this narrative point, “后来” is needed; sentence-initial “以后” requires a specified prior time or event.
This refers to people generally, so “人们” is appropriate rather than “别人,” which means other people.
